headline: Pay DTH shrinks,
IPTV keeps adding homes

events.text: Pay DTH active base at 56.07 million subscribers
Airtel IPTV at 35.95 lakh; pay DTH at 49.09 million
Pay DTH falls to 48.56 million, down 13.4% in a year
IPTV at 6.21 million, Airtel alone 4.09 million

note: Mobile data: 28.39 GB per user a month at ₹7.13/GB
